( ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_READ_DUTY d0 WHERE d0.IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo} AND d0.SALL_YN = 'Y' ) AND u.USER_SE = 'USR' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_READ_DUTY_TGT t WHERE t.IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo} AND ( ( t.STGT_TY = 'DEPT' AND t.STGT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID ) OR ( t.STGT_TY = 'USER' AND t.STGT_ID = u.ESNTL_ID ) ) ) )
mapper.select: SELECT d.IDUTY_NO "dutyNo", d.ILAW_ID "lawId", d.IPROM_NO "promNo", d.SALL_YN "allYn", d.SDUE_DT "dueDt", d.SINS_ID "insId", d.SINS_NM "insNm", d.SINS_DT "insDt" FROM TB_READ_DUTY d WHERE d.IPROM_NO = #{promNo}

SELECT t.STGT_TY "tgtTy", t.STGT_ID "tgtId", CASE WHEN t.STGT_TY = 'DEPT' THEN NVL((SELECT o.ORGNZT_NM FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO o WHERE o.ORGNZT_ID = t.STGT_ID), t.STGT_ID) ELSE NVL((SELECT MAX(u.USER_NM || ' (' || u.USER_ID || ')') FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u WHERE u.ESNTL_ID = t.STGT_ID), t.STGT_ID) END "tgtNm" FROM TB_READ_DUTY_TGT t WHERE t.IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo} ORDER BY t.STGT_TY, 3
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_READ_DUTY ( IDUTY_NO, ILAW_ID, IPROM_NO, SALL_YN, SDUE_DT, SINS_ID, SINS_NM, SINS_DT ) VALUES ( #{dutyNo}, (SELECT p.ILAW_ID FROM TB_PROM p WHERE p.IPROM_NO = #{promNo}), #{promNo}, #{allYn}, #{dueDt}, #{insId}, #{insNm}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') )
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_READ_DUTY SET SALL_YN = #{allYn}, SDUE_DT = #{dueDt}, SINS_ID = #{insId}, SINS_NM = #{insNm}, SINS_DT = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') WHERE IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_READ_DUTY_TGT (IDUTY_NO, STGT_TY, STGT_ID) VALUES (#{dutyNo}, #{tgtTy}, #{tgtId})

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.IDUTY_NO "dutyNo", d.IPROM_NO "promNo", p.STITLE "title", p.SPROM_DT "promDate", d.SDUE_DT "dueDt", CASE WHEN d.SDUE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(d.SDUE_DT, '%Y%m%d'), DATE(SYSDATE())) END "dday", c.SREAD_DT "readDt", CASE WHEN p.SSTART_DT > TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYY-MM-DD') THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END "pendingYn" FROM TB_READ_DUTY d JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = d.IPROM_NO AND p.SDISP_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_READ_DUTY_CHK c ON c.IDUTY_NO = d.IDUTY_NO AND c.SUSER_ID = #{esntlId} WHERE c.SCONF_DT IS NULL AND ORDER BY CASE WHEN d.SDUE_DT IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, d.SDUE_DT ASC, d.SINS_DT DESC ) X LIMIT #{n}

SELECT d.IDUTY_NO "dutyNo", d.SDUE_DT "dueDt", CASE WHEN d.SDUE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(d.SDUE_DT, '%Y%m%d'), DATE(SYSDATE())) END "dday", c.SREAD_DT "readDt", c.SCONF_DT "confDt", CASE WHEN c.SCONF_DT IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 11, 2) END "confDtFmt" FROM TB_READ_DUTY d LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_READ_DUTY_CHK c ON c.IDUTY_NO = d.IDUTY_NO AND c.SUSER_ID = #{esntlId} WHERE d.IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND
mapper.update: INSERT INTO TB_READ_DUTY_CHK (IDUTY_NO, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NM, SORGNZT_ID, SREAD_DT) VALUES (#{dutyNo}, #{esntlId}, #{userNm}, #{orgnztId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SREAD_DT = NVL(SREAD_DT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))

INSERT INTO TB_READ_DUTY_CHK (IDUTY_NO, SUSER_ID, SUSER_NM, SORGNZT_ID, SREAD_DT, SCONF_DT) VALUES (#{dutyNo}, #{esntlId}, #{userNm}, #{orgnztId}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE SCONF_DT = NVL(SCONF_DT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')), SREAD_DT = NVL(SREAD_DT, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'))

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT d.IDUTY_NO "dutyNo", d.IPROM_NO "promNo", d.ILAW_ID "lawId", p.STITLE "title", p.SPROM_DT "promDate", d.SALL_YN "allYn", d.SDUE_DT "dueDt", d.SINS_NM "insNm", SUBSTR(d.SINS_DT, 1, 8) "insDt", NVL(x.TGT_CNT, 0) "tgtCnt", NVL(x.READ_CNT, 0) "readCnt", NVL(x.CONF_CNT, 0) "confCnt", CASE WHEN d.SDUE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(d.SDUE_DT, '%Y%m%d'), DATE(SYSDATE())) END "dday" FROM TB_READ_DUTY d JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = d.IPROM_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT dd.IDUTY_NO, COUNT(u.ESNTL_ID) TGT_CNT, COUNT(c.SREAD_DT) READ_CNT, COUNT(c.SCONF_DT) CONF_CNT FROM TB_READ_DUTY dd JOIN COMVNUSERMASTER u ON ( ( dd.SALL_YN = 'Y' AND u.USER_SE = 'USR' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_READ_DUTY_TGT t WHERE t.IDUTY_NO = dd.IDUTY_NO AND ( ( t.STGT_TY = 'DEPT' AND t.STGT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID ) OR ( t.STGT_TY = 'USER' AND t.STGT_ID = u.ESNTL_ID ) ) ) ) LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_READ_DUTY_CHK c ON c.IDUTY_NO = dd.IDUTY_NO AND c.SUSER_ID = u.ESNTL_ID GROUP BY dd.IDUTY_NO ) x ON x.IDUTY_NO = d.IDUTY_NO WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.STITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%'
ORDER BY d.SINS_DT DESC, d.IDUTY_NO DESC ) X LIMIT 500

SELECT d.IDUTY_NO "dutyNo", d.IPROM_NO "promNo", d.ILAW_ID "lawId", p.STITLE "title", p.SPROM_DT "promDate", d.SALL_YN "allYn", d.SDUE_DT "dueDt", d.SINS_NM "insNm", SUBSTR(d.SINS_DT, 1, 8) "insDt", CASE WHEN d.SDUE_DT IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(STR_TO_DATE(d.SDUE_DT, '%Y%m%d'), DATE(SYSDATE())) END "dday" FROM TB_READ_DUTY d JOIN TB_PROM p ON p.IPROM_NO = d.IPROM_NO WHERE d.IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo}

SELECT u.ESNTL_ID "esntlId", u.USER_ID "userId", u.USER_NM "userNm", NVL(o.ORGNZT_NM, '(부서 미지정)') "orgnztNm", c.SREAD_DT "readDt", c.SCONF_DT "confDt", CASE WHEN c.SREAD_DT IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(c.SREAD_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.SREAD_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.SREAD_DT, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(c.SREAD_DT, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(c.SREAD_DT, 11, 2) END "readDtFmt", CASE WHEN c.SCONF_DT IS NOT NULL THEN SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 1, 4) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 5, 2) || '-' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 7, 2) || ' ' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 9, 2) || ':' || SUBSTR(c.SCONF_DT, 11, 2) END "confDtFmt" FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_READ_DUTY_CHK c ON c.IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo} AND c.SUSER_ID = u.ESNTL_ID WHERE ORDER BY 4, u.USER_NM, u.USER_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT u.ESNTL_ID AS "esntlId", u.USER_ID AS "userId", u.USER_NM AS "userNm", (SELECT g.ORGNZT_NM FROM COMTNORGNZTINFO g WHERE g.ORGNZT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID) AS "orgnztNm" FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u WHERE UPPER(u.USER_NM) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR UPPER(u.USER_ID) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{keyword}) || '%' ORDER BY u.USER_NM, u.USER_ID ) X LIMIT 20

SELECT NVL(o.ORGNZT_NM, '(부서 미지정)') "orgnztNm", COUNT(*) "tgtCnt", COUNT(c.SREAD_DT) "readCnt", COUNT(c.SCONF_DT) "confCnt" FROM COMVNUSERMASTER u LEFT OUTER JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = u.ORGNZT_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_READ_DUTY_CHK c ON c.IDUTY_NO = #{dutyNo} AND c.SUSER_ID = u.ESNTL_ID WHERE GROUP BY NVL(o.ORGNZT_NM, '(부서 미지정)') ORDER BY 1
